rca_of_issue: RCA — Café banner shows 'Member' instead of real first name. Root cause: /app/backend/services/status/service.py::get_looking() (lines 288-307) projects only fields `{id, name, avatar_url, suburb}` from db.users and returns `u.get('name')` verbatim. For real accounts (Alex, all demo users) the `name` field is unset — the display name lives in `first_name`. As a result the backend returns name=null for every looker, and CafeLookingBanner falls back to the string 'Member' (component code lines 155 & 201: `{lookers[0].name || 'Someone'}` / `{m.name || 'Member'}`). Reproduction: seed any real user as looking (see /tmp/seed2.py) → visit /table/fp-cafe-permanent as another nearby user → banner row reads '🦋 Member' instead of '🦋 Margaret'. Mitigation: expand the projection to include `first_name` and `username`, and in the response builder use `u.get('name') or u.get('first_name') or u.get('username')`. This is safe & purely additive — no schema change required.
